# Solutions Architect Interview

> Architecture design, customer discovery, and presentation rounds, with loops at five cloud and data companies. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [AWS vs. Azure vs. GCP: Service Translation Table](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/aws-vs-azure-vs-gcp-services.md): The three large cloud platforms offer the same building blocks under different names.
- [Common Mistakes in the Solutions Architect Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Most candidates who fail a solutions architect (SA) loop know enough technology to pass it.
- [Cloud Cost Estimation](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/cost-estimation.md): A cloud bill is the sum of a few cost drivers, and each driver is a quantity multiplied by a unit price.
- [Design Round Framework](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/design-round-framework.md): A solutions architect (SA) design answer has ten steps in four phases.
- [Four-Week Preparation Plan](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/four-week-plan.md): This plan prepares every round of a solutions architect (SA) loop in four weeks at 8 to 10 hours a week.
- [Migration and Disaster Recovery](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/migration-and-disaster-recovery.md): Two question types appear in most solutions architect (SA) design rounds: "move this to the cloud" and "make this survive a failure".
- [Solutions Architect Interview Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/question-bank.md): Fifty practice questions for the solutions architect (SA) interview, grouped by round.
- [Solutions Architect Interview vs. System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/solutions-architect-vs-system-design-interview.md): A software engineering system design interview asks whether the candidate can build a system.

## Companies

- [AWS Solutions Architect Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/companies/aws.md): The AWS solutions architect (SA) interview is commonly reported to have a recruiter call, an optional online assessment, a phone screen, a final loop, and a presentation.
- [Databricks Solutions Architect Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/companies/databricks.md): Databricks publishes its own interview guide for solutions architect (SA) roles, which makes this the best documented loop in this repository.
- [Google Cloud Customer Engineer Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/companies/google-cloud.md): Google Cloud calls its solutions architect role customer engineer.
- [Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/companies/microsoft.md): Microsoft calls the role cloud solution architect, and the job mainly starts after the customer has signed.
- [Snowflake Sales Engineer Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/companies/snowflake.md): Snowflake usually titles its solutions architect role sales engineer or solutions engineer.

## Rounds

- [The Architecture Design Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/architecture-design.md): In the architecture design round, the candidate designs a system for one customer's need and defends each trade-off while the interviewer changes the requirements.
- [The Behavioral Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/behavioral.md): Behavioral interviews for a solutions architect (SA) ask about past customers, conflicts, and failures.
- [The Customer Discovery Role-Play](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/customer-discovery-role-play.md): In the customer role-play, the interviewer acts as a customer and the candidate acts as the solutions architect (SA).
- [The Solutions Architect Interview Loop](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/interview-loop.md): Most solutions architect (SA) loops start with a recruiter screen and one or two technical or hiring manager screens.
- [The Presentation Round](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/presentation.md): The presentation round tests whether a senior customer audience would understand a recommendation and act on it.
- [The Technical Screen](https://github.com/design-gurus/solutions-architect-interview/blob/main/rounds/technical-screen.md): The technical screen checks breadth before the full loop.
